observations.contract: Parsed configuration and native float semantics
observations.trace: TacticalGraphicsConfig::parse deserializes YAML to concrete f32 fields, then validates. The root_occlusion predicate only checks <=0 or >1; maximum_push is compared only against a positive finite minimum. IEEE unordered comparisons leave both guards false for NaN, and positive infinity also passes the maximum check. By contrast positive() and bounded() explicitly require finite values. The locked serde-saphyr 1.2.0 source routes typed f32 through parse_yaml12_float; in its ordinary non-angle branch YAML .nan and .inf map to nonfinite values, and default options disable angle conversion. The locked serde_core f32 visitor returns the supplied f32.
observations.remaining: This is a source-level path and conditional logic, not an executed YAML document, resolved feature graph, complete tokenization or product startup. Other fields and all producer constraints must also pass. Positive infinity is a separate support-policy question, not automatically an observed error.

observations.trace: Instanced grass material creation copies root_occlusion into the params uniform, and the shader uses params.x in its root-shadow interpolation. The player hook inserts GrassInteractor on the local player. The scheduled grass interaction system returns if no interactor, may skip unchanged state, and only enters the material loop if materials exist. Within that loop it calls f32::clamp with minimum_push and maximum_push. The repository-pinned Rust source states and implements that clamp rejects a NaN bound.
observations.remaining: If a NaN maximum has reached settings, an interactor exists, the update is not skipped and at least one grass material is iterated, source predicts a clamp panic. None of those runtime conditions, panic behavior or GPU output was observed. NaN root shading consequences remain unverified; the two fields share admission but have distinct consumers.

observations.trace: validate_tier requires both configured topology dimensions to be nonzero but imposes no upper bound here. The tuft placement casts configured usize to i32 and loops 0..side; the blade mesh computes grid_side * grid_side. Symbolically, 2^31+1 fits 32- and 64-bit usize, casts to -2147483647 in i32, and its side-minus-one remains representable, yielding an empty positive-start range if the lattice body is entered. On a 64-bit target, 2^32 squared exceeds usize capacity.
observations.remaining: No configuration was parsed, allocated or executed; valid target/resource policy, multiplication behavior under actual compilation, supported sizes and all native buffer consumers remain open. Do not describe authored defaults as broken.

observations.trace: parse formats its YAML error into String; native load similarly formats metadata and read errors with the path, and both native and browser startup display a final panic string. Regional-city jobs parse graphics and wrap that message in a typed PreparationError::GraphicsConfiguration, preserving the outer category but not the earlier typed parser cause. Config explicitly validates finite cloud quality/resolution, and headless mode disables cloud effects.
observations.remaining: Exact native IO/parser error policy, all error consumers and deduplication with audio or other configuration families remain open. Leaf error display, enabled/disabled and headless choices are not compatibility defects.

observations.contract: Scene, door, furniture and worker scopes
observations.trace: ActiveTacticalScene records the most recently activated live environment and falls back to the prior live entity. Door presentation treats city-gate visibility separately from ordinary building closure visibility. Outdoor furniture producer creates identity-transform children under its root, narrowing the earlier same-root GPU-part transform concern. GenerationJob retains typed RegionalCity/Building/Venue alternatives and requires the appropriate owner where specified.
observations.remaining: All environment producers, camera cardinality, furniture transform writers, native ECS scheduling and generation product/receipt admissions remain independently open. Earlier bounded current traces and source fixtures are not execution evidence.
